_preregistration.primary: does any downstream layer L increase its contribution when the early block is ablated -- delta(L) = [lambda(early) - lambda(early+L)] - [lambda(none) - lambda(L)] > 0 above the seed floor?
_preregistration.rung: `none` and `attn_early` must re-measure within 0.0611 of their recorded {'none': 0.3566, 'attn_early': 0.0115} or the borrowed singles are not comparable and nothing is decidable
_preregistration.kill: no downstream layer increases its contribution -> static redundancy explains F80's non-additivity without compensation, self-repair is not the mechanism, and explanandum route 5 closes. A NULL IS A GOOD RESULT
_preregistration.not_decidable: the seed floor is too large for a compensation of 0.05 to clear a 2x gate (power), or arms fail to ignite (F42). NOTE: a flat delta series is NOT undecidable -- it is the kill
_preregistration.multiple_comparisons: the largest delta is the MAX over the compared layers, so its significance is family-wise, not per-comparison
_preregistration.directional: reported, NOT blocking: a negative delta is evidence against self-repair rather than an inability to decide
_preregistration.reuse: lambda(attn_L{L}) read from results/ablate_layers.json (F80), gated on the rung
_preregistration.secondary: IGNITION REVIVAL, registered in its own right: downstream ablations whose ignition rate exceeds the reference's by more than 0.25. Removing more of the network making damage spread further contradicts any monotone account of ablation. Reported whether or not the primary decides, so a comparability exclusion cannot quietly dispose of it
_preregistration.competing_account: single-token sensitivity s, measured exactly (s_crn, no seeds) on a FIXED ensemble from the unablated ring so the model varies and the ensemble does not (F96/F99). If s(none) > 1/r >= s(attn_early), annealed mean field predicts the ignition collapse with no compensation in the account, and a positive delta must survive that rather than ignore it
_preregistration.boundary: attributes non-additivity to a mechanism in one model, one family, greedy

verdict: RUNG: none: recorded +0.3566, re-measured +0.3566 (8/8 ignited) -> reproduces; attn_early: recorded +0.0115, re-measured +0.0115 (7/8 ignited) -> reproduces REVIVAL: against a reference igniting at 0.148, 1 downstream ablations RAISE ignition (L8:0.484) and 0 lower it. Removing MORE of the network making damage spread FURTHER is not what any monotone account of ablation predicts, and it is measured here rather than filtered away. COMPARABILITY: reference `attn_early` ignites at 0.148; 15 of 16 downstream arms are within 0.25 of it. DROPPED as not comparable: L8(0.484). PRIMARY: largest delta is L23 at +0.09177 (contribution -0.01419 intact -> +0.07758 with the early block ablated), against a seed floor of 0.03443. 4 of 15 layers exceed the floor. NOT DECIDABLE: the run is underpowered for its own question -- noise_gate: numerator is 0.05 against a noise floor of 0.03443 (1.45x, gate 2.0x). A compensation of 0.05 would not have cleared this floor, so neither the positive nor the kill can be read. More seeds, not more layers. SENSITIVITY: s(none)=0.81741, s(attn_early)=0.85969, mean-field critical 1/r=0.3333. The early block does NOT cross the critical point, so the sensitivity account does not by itself explain the ignition collapse and the compensation reading keeps its standing. BOUNDARY: this attributes F80's non-additivity to a named mechanism in ONE model of ONE family at one checkpoint, under greedy decoding. It does not show lambda_ca measures self-repair in general, and the generality debt is unchanged.
